title: HONOR Pad X7b offers an affordable tablet experience under PHP 10,000 exclusively on TikTok Shop
summary: Global AI device provider HONOR Philippines is giving Filipino consumers an early opportunity to get the HONOR Pad X7b, exclusively on TikTok Shop starting November 6 as part of the TikTok 11.11 Big…

blocks.text: Global AI device provider HONOR Philippines is giving Filipino consumers an early opportunity to get the HONOR Pad X7b, exclusively on TikTok Shop starting November 6 as part of the TikTok 11.11 Big Bang Sale. From its PHP 10,999 SRP, shoppers can get the tablet for only PHP 8,999, with a special PHP 2,000 early-bird discount available until November 13, 2026.

Designed for entertainment, browsing, reading, and everyday tasks, the HONOR Pad X7b features a 9.7-inch 2K HONOR Eye Comfort Display with a 90Hz refresh rate for smooth and comfortable viewing. It is powered by an 8,000mAh battery for extended use and comes with SGS 5-star Enhanced Drop and Crush Resistance Certification, providing added durability for everyday handling.

“We’re excited to bring the HONOR Pad X7b to Filipino consumers first through TikTok Shop, with an exclusive early bird offer that makes it even more accessible,” said Stephen Cheng, Vice President of HONOR Philippines. “With its 2K Eye Comfort Display, long-lasting battery, and enhanced durability, the HONOR Pad X7b is designed to support both entertainment and everyday productivity. We invite everyone to take advantage of this special offer during the TikTok 11.11 Big Bang Sale.”
Get the HONOR Pad X7b for Only PHP 8,999 on TikTok Shop
From November 6 to 13, customers can get the HONOR Pad X7b for only PHP 8,999, down from its PHP 10,999 SRP, through the exclusive PHP 2,000 early-bird discount on TikTok Shop.
Customers can also enjoy 0% interest installments for up to six months through TikTok PayLater, making it easier to bring home the new HONOR tablet.

Shoppers can also catch their favorite creators featuring the HONOR Pad X7b during the TikTok 11.11 Big Bang Sale. Viewers can enjoy exclusive livestream offers and get access to the lowest price during participating livestreams.
The HONOR Pad X7b will be available exclusively on TikTok Shop starting November 6, ahead of its official launch and nationwide availability on November 28, 2026.

For more information about HONOR Philippines, you may visit: https://www.honor.com/ph/.
